1. Workforce balance: W_t = W_{t-1} + H_t - F_t (W_0 = 1,000)

- Raw materials: 90 × Σ P_t
- Outsourcing: 200 × Σ O_t
- Inventory holding: 15 × Σ I_t (t=1..6)
- Backorders: 35 × Σ B_t (t=1..5)
